promptTemplates.name: Demo Baseline PCT Prompt
promptTemplates.description: Simple baseline prompt for public demo workspace imports.
promptTemplates.text: Use the provided PCT benchmark case data. Return valid JSON using the app scoring schema. Do not provide medical advice. Do not use or infer a hidden reference answer.

promptTemplates.name: Demo Structured PCT JSON Prompt
promptTemplates.description: Criterion-by-criterion prompt for public demo workspace imports.
promptTemplates.text: Evaluate the case against these benchmark rules only: clinical improvement is required; LRTI/non-ICU threshold is 0.25 ng/mL; sepsis/ICU threshold is 0.5 ng/mL; PCT decline greater than 80% is a trend criterion; exclusion/caution conditions require clinical review. Return only valid JSON with recommendation, structured criteria, calculation_audit, pct_interpretation, reasoning_summary, safety_warnings, missing_information, and confidence. Do not include medical advice.

promptTemplates.name: Demo A1 Intake and Validation Prompt
promptTemplates.description: Extract benchmark-critical fields and missing data.
promptTemplates.text: A1 task: extract infection context, current antibiotic status, clinical improvement, peak PCT, current PCT, and exclusion/caution condition. Identify missing benchmark-critical fields. Do not make a final recommendation. Return valid JSON.

promptTemplates.name: Demo A2 Clinical Reasoning Prompt
promptTemplates.description: Apply PCT benchmark rules without final recommendation.
promptTemplates.text: A2 task: apply PCT benchmark rules using case data and prior output. Distinguish absolute threshold, PCT decline, clinical improvement, and exclusion/caution gate. Do not produce the final recommendation. Return valid JSON.

promptTemplates.name: Demo A3 Kinetic and Context Analysis Prompt
promptTemplates.description: Calculate PCT decline and gate criteria.
promptTemplates.text: A3 task: calculate PCT decline as ((peak_pct - current_pct) / peak_pct) * 100 when possible. Assess current PCT against the applicable threshold, PCT decline >80%, clinical improvement, and exclusion/caution gate. Do not produce the final recommendation. Return valid JSON.

promptTemplates.name: Demo A4 Final Structured Report Prompt
promptTemplates.description: Final parseable scoring output for demo workflow.
promptTemplates.text: A4 task: synthesize case data and prior workflow outputs. Return only parseable JSON using the app scoring schema: recommendation, absolute_threshold_met, pct_decline_threshold_met, clinical_improvement_required, clinical_improvement_present, exclusion_condition_present, safety_gate_passed, calculation_audit, pct_interpretation, threshold_used, pct_decline_calculated, reasoning_summary, safety_warnings, missing_information, confidence. Do not say stop antibiotics immediately. Do not use or infer a hidden reference answer.
